title: huperzia lindenii
intro: Huperzia lindenii, commonly known as the forked spleenwort or linden spleenwort, is a species of plant in the family Huperziaceae. It is a type of liverwort, a group of non-vascular plants that are typically found in shaded, humid environments. The health benefits of Huperzia lindenii include its potential to support cognitive function and memory, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Huperzia lindenii include huperzine A, a sesquiterpene alkaloid that has been shown to exhibit neuroprotective and therapeutic actions, such as inhibiting acetylcholinesterase and modulating neurotransmitter release.
